Bring your own Gemma.

Connect an Ollama endpoint to generate a structured experiment plan and explanation. Curated examples and calculations work without a model.

Requests go directly to your endpoint. For local HTTP inference, run this app locally too. The hosted HTTPS app may require an HTTPS model proxy and allowed origins. No model is running on this site.

WHAT'S ACTUALLY HAPPENING

Beautiful, with the working shown.

Gemma chooses a supported experiment and explains calculated results. It cannot execute arbitrary code. Without Gemma, the question box selects curated examples by keywords.

Custom fields accept a restricted mathematical expression syntax. Symbolic derivatives use math.js. Line and surface integrals use independent midpoint quadrature; numerical agreement is evidence, not proof.

The singular-field example intentionally violates the disk's smoothness assumptions. No claim of new mathematical discovery is made.

Three.js draws the 3D scene; a projected Canvas renderer supports browsers without WebGL. Particle paths use numerical integration. Sources and setup instructions are included in the source download.

Review your experiment

Check the formula before running the experiment. Validation checks syntax, not whether the interpretation matches your intent.
